def make_a_pile(n):
    pile = [n]
    odd = n if n % 2 != 0 else n + 1
    even = n if n % 2 == 0 else n + 1
    is_odd = n % 2 != 0

    while len(pile) < n:
        if is_odd:
            odd += 2
            pile.append(odd)
        else:
            even += 2
            pile.append(even)
        is_odd = not is_odd

    return pile
